purpose: Maintainer feedback 6784701926: generic UIKit clipped-row, large tree, duplicate safety, landscape and placed-window evidence. Existing frozen bundles are untouched.

attribution.runtimeNote: Matched performance, duplicate, clipped-cover and iPad cases ran at 380/3cac. Previous a3 differs from 380 only in three test/fixture files; production source and all 629 dist JS hashes were unchanged. The distinct 71f native binary separately passed eight native tests and a d006 smoke at a3. Final bef changes JavaScript guard/recovery behavior and is separately hashed and verified by one identical d006 750 ms smoke with the same 71f native binary; no bef/380 JS equality is claimed.

deviceScope: Fresh owned iPad Pro 13-inch (M5), iOS 27.0; one portrait placed-window ref only

clippedRow.result: Original 5a, 965 and 380 each delivered seven intended row 0 taps in the matched portrait phases, including a CLI press. No filler row received a tap. In this fixture, native isHittable does not require the center of the raw frame to lie inside the visible rectangle. This does not certify arbitrary points.

largeTree.base5a: Seven intended taps on other-000. Ref median 561.38 ms, range 546.81–570.02 ms.
largeTree.intermediate965: The first selector was explicitly canceled at 15002 ms while the native query was still enumerating. Zero taps; one query accepted and none completed by client return. This is not a natural request deadline measurement. Further failed trials were skipped.
largeTree.candidate380: Seven intended taps on other-000. Ref median 800.51 ms, range 775.88–801.54 ms. One readiness call per ready press; the three native ref reads took 316, 327 and 334 ms. CLI exit 0 in 987.28 ms.
largeTree.methodLimit: Small sequential observations; no general performance claim or pass threshold.

duplicates.distinctFrames: The intended blocked A remains blocked although a public selector read chooses hittable B. The ambiguous selector refuses input. An A ref is explicitly canceled after 2 s without any tap or cover event. A fresh B ref then delivers B only.
duplicates.exactSameFrame: Both bindings share type, identifier, label and rectangle (24,650,340,48). Native strict reads report ambiguous for each. The selector refuses AMBIGUOUS_MATCH with dispatched:no. The ref refuses target_not_ready, readiness:ambiguous and dispatched:no. No input events occur.

clippedFullCover.fixtureVersion: Separate v1.1 bundle; the v1 latency binary is unchanged.
clippedFullCover.geometry: The 400 pt Cell keeps its raw center at y=50 outside the visible 70 pt tail. A real UIView fully covers that tail. Before, covered and after snapshots and native reads are retained.
clippedFullCover.observed: At 380, direct strict native reads report ready → blocked → ready. A 2 s caller cancellation while blocked delivers no input through the 750 ms fade removal and a 1.2 s observation. A fresh ref then delivers one row 0 tap; cover touches remain zero. Public cancellation retains the documented request_canceled / dispatched:unknown transport evidence. The 965 phase has the same pending-ref cancellation and recovery observations; its covered public read returned no target, so direct covered-state readiness samples were not obtained there.
clippedFullCover.claimLimit: This case proves blocked state and cancellation/recovery. It does not measure implicit completion of a clipped fade.

landscape: Matched 5a, 965 and 380 selector/ref/CLI phases each deliver seven row 0 taps. The 380 CLI exits 0 in 537.39 ms. Individual times and native read counts are in LATENCY-SUMMARY.json.

iPadPlacedWindow.capture: Fresh state and runner; foreground:false open; customActions private-AX requested-backend capture; external recording. Direct source/live evidence precedes one ordinary ref.
iPadPlacedWindow.observed: Native ready three times; ordinary ref completed in 472.21 ms and delivered exactly one native action tap. This is a functional observation.
iPadPlacedWindow.eventFieldNote: The older geometry fixture key actionScreenFrame is window-local UIView.convert(to:nil), despite its name. It is not used as screen-space proof; direct native live/source frames provide that proof.

finalSmoke.result: Final bef/71f exits 0 with underlying 1 / overlay 0. Fade completes at 12974.27 ms, then the tap arrives at 13138.38 ms. closeMs=970.53; pressMs=871.79.

privacy.boundedVisualAudit: All 55 included PNGs were inspected: every included video first/last frame and each standalone screenshot. Content is limited to generic UIKit fixtures, synthetic controls and default simulator OS. This is not full frame-by-frame video playback.
privacy.excluded: Settings/window-setup captures, invalid diagnostic setups, leases/tokens, global diagnostics and full native logs/xcresults are omitted.

limitations: No physical-device, macOS, iPad landscape, Stage Manager or general multiwindow coverage claim.
Only eight selected native tests were run at each named candidate; no full native-suite claim.
No partial-center occlusion certification. Native hittability remains a necessary condition for the control.
The intermediate 965 failure used explicit caller cancellation after 15 s; no 60 s product timeout is claimed.
